profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Ascend
profile.summary: I am full stack engineer with a strong passion for web development. I enjoy solving everyday problems and discovering better alternatives to augment user interaction with web applications. I’m infatuated with developing tools that are coded with efficient algorithms and provide innovative technologies that solve many of the problems that exist today.

projects.title: KA-VR
projects.description:
Virtual Assistant that exists as a chrome extension allowing users to perform various functions by simply talking to KA-VR. Voice commands can be used to search for web images, grab a video, get the weather for a location, or bring up top restaurant recommendations. KA-VR also learns from the users when it encounter new words and remembers the next time users ask it again. 

Contributions
. Built front-end UI using React and Redux for managing application state
. Designed modular system architecture for future scalability
. Reduced number of expensive queries and API calls by identifying commonly
used actions and utilizing additional databases to store commonly used data
. Structured implementation of API for easier expansion of functionality
. Integrated machine learning algorithm in Neo4j to accommodate new user inputs . Built text analyzer for natural language process to understand user intentions
